description: Lists all versions of one game, newest first (read-only, needs login): number, state (uploading, testing, tested, test_failed, awaiting_review, approved, rejected, archived, ...), which one is live, release notes, size, autotest status, reject reasons with fixes and dates. For the latest version's full autotest report and the next step use gamealia_get_status.

game.description: Game slug or id, from gamealia_list_games (a game of the active account)
